messages:
Nora Li: Quick sync: Snow + Databricks + Qdrant bundle go-live planning. Need owners for marketplace listing, SI enablement, and pricing.
Diego Ramirez: I can take marketplace listing. Will confirm container vs descriptor with Snow PM.
Priya Shah: I'll own SI enablement and runbook. Propose two webinars the week before launch.
Nora Li: Tentative date from partners is 2026-05-12. Can we hit that?
Diego Ramirez: Depends on legal + compliance signoff. Add 2-week buffer for marketplace review.
Ecosystem Bot: Reminder: listing checklist includes product schema, logos, lead contact, support email. Deadline in 10 days.
Priya Shah: For Qdrant, we need a sample batch upsert and vector schema. Diego, can you include a minimal snippet in the listing? e.g. `curl -X POST /vectors -d '{"id":"1","values":[0.12,0.34]}'`
Diego Ramirez: Yep, I'll add a short ingest example and link to the repo.
Nora Li: Actions: Diego -> marketplace listing draft by 4/3; Priya -> SI runbook + webinar invites by 4/6; Nora -> pricing/legal coordination. Sync Friday for status. :white_check_mark:
